ownership_parameters.fill: per-channel page-ring median; round to native uint8

geometry_policy: CP2 fallback once per source-bound page; >=10GB free; separate cache; geometry_unavailable is policy, not screen error
orientation_policy: CP5c unknown allowed for orientation only; never a verified KEEP
fresh_sampling: ADM4 included, candidate_usable true, W1 union W2; locked/eval and calibration IDs only excluded
end_clip_policy: Option C: admitted known class; edge_clip_candidate is diagnostic lower bound only
